title: MentalChat16K: A Benchmark Dataset for Conversational Mental Health Assistance

bias_targets.methodology: Using LLM-as-a-judge (GPT-4 Turbo and Gemini Pro) and human experts to score generated counseling responses on an 'Open-mindedness & Non-judgment' metric, evaluating whether the AI approaches the user without bias or judgment and remains free from biases related to personal attributes.
